intro.skipHint: Skips the introduction and goes to wallet setup

nadir.title: Nadir
nadir.body: A self-custody wallet for testnet practice. Learn how keys, backups and sends work without risking real money.

keys.title: Your keys stay here
keys.body: Your recovery phrase is created and kept on this device. A passcode, plus biometric unlock if you want it, locks the app.

practice.title: Practice, not payments
practice.body: Nadir is testnet-only, and sends are simulated: nothing is signed or broadcast. The camera is only used when you scan a code or run a face check.

welcome.tagline: Self-custody for multi-chain assets. Your keys, your crypto — secured by design.
welcome.trustKeys: Your recovery phrase stays on this device. The backend only ever sees public wallet addresses.
welcome.trustTestnet: Testnet-only demo — balances and prices are estimated and hold no real value.

explain.title: Self-custody
explain.keysBody: Your recovery phrase is created on this device and never leaves it. No accounts, no bank, no middleman.
explain.phraseTitle: A recovery phrase is your backup
explain.phraseBody: Twelve words are the master key to your wallet. Write them down and keep them offline.
explain.recoverBody: Nadir never sees your phrase. If you lose it, no one — including us — can restore your wallet.

reveal.title: Recovery phrase
reveal.warning: Write these 12 words down in order and store them offline. Never share them. Don't screenshot.
reveal.demoNote: This is a real recovery phrase. Nadir is testnet-only and simulates sends, but keep the phrase private anyway.

passcode.title: App passcode
passcode.confirmHint: Enter it once more to confirm
passcode.saveFailed: Couldn't save the passcode. Try again.

biometric.title: Enable {{biometry}}
biometric.body: Use {{biometry}} to unlock your wallet instead of typing your passcode.

ready.title: You're all set
ready.body: Your wallet is ready and secured. Welcome to self-custody.
ready.saveFailed: Couldn't save your wallet on this device, so it isn't set up yet. Try again.

import.title: Import wallet
import.placeholder: Enter your 12 or 24-word recovery phrase, separated by spaces
import.invalidChecksum: This phrase is invalid — its checksum doesn't match.
import.securityNote: Your phrase is stored only on this device and never leaves it.

backup.title: Back up wallet
backup.introBody: Your recovery phrase is the only way to restore your wallet. We'll show 12 words — write them down and keep them offline.
backup.introNote: Nadir is non-custodial — no one, including us, can recover this phrase for you.
backup.doneBody: Your recovery phrase is verified. Your security score just went up.
backup.revealGate: Requires your biometrics or device passcode
